title: Planned-to-produced flip checklist for new profilers
lead: Nothing says what sq-09, sq-10 or sq-15 must change when a planned member becomes produced: descriptor.md (key-order rows, dialect table, Planned section, interim members, changelog), the schema (members, enums, oneOf), the schemaVersion const and `$id`, the test lists (DocumentedMembersTests planned list, PlannedMembersTests planned lists, SchemaValueTests enum pins), and the KeyOrderPin exception. Add a checklist bullet in CONTRIBUTING.md next to the schema-change rule and notes on sq-09, sq-10 and sq-15.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: 1. List every place by flipping a planned member in a scratch copy; 2. write the checklist; 3. docs test if the rule lists phrases.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: Build, test and format pass; `slicer check` passes.
